title: Updating the Target Register
statement: For a program register state with value vector $(p,n,a,b,s,t,tmp,st,nx)$, replacing its entry at index $5$ by $z\in\mathbb{N}$ gives the value vector of the state obtained by replacing $t$ by $z$.
replaced:
Let a register state be the 9-tuple $(p,n,a,b,s,t,tmp,st,nx)$ of natural numbers, and
let its register vector list these entries in order at indices $0$ through $8$.
Replacing entry $5$ of this vector by any $z\in\mathbb{N}$ gives the register vector of
the state obtained by replacing $t$ by $z$.
